description.value: All commercially available augmentations are tailor-made to the individual undergoing installation. You have, however, tinkered with your body to the point where you're confident you can accept any augmentation, even one not made for you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Monster Crafting] feat and can use it to gather materials needed to make augmentations to install in yourself. The augmentations must match the type of creature being salvaged, such as a construct for cybernetics, a dragon for magitech, or an undead for necrografts.
